title: Macworld Podcast: iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro, and more
content:
Macworld

On this episode of the Macworld Podcast, we talk about Apple’s new iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone Duo, Apple Watch Series 12, and a lot more. Tune in to find out more! 

This is episode 999 with Michael Simon, Jason Cross, and Roman Loyola.
